title: GestAdapt: Workspace-Conditioned Co-Speech Gesture Generation for Humanoid Robots
abstract: arXiv:2609.38400v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Co-speech gestures for robots must adapt not only to speech and embodiment, but also to the workspace available for performing the motion. Since the same speech can be accompanied by different gestures, a robot can respond to workspace constraints, e.g., gestures for speech next to a wall. In these scenarios, the robot should gesture in a suitable motion rather than simply correcting an unconstrained one. To achieve this goal, we present GestAdapt, a workspace-conditioned framework that conditions co-speech gesture generation on a prescribed wrist workspace. The GestAdapt framework learns from six complementary co-speech corpora through a shared motion representation and supports retargeting to different robot embodiments. Quantitative evaluation shows that generated motions remain close to the real-motion distribution while respecting the workspace. translated_title: GestAdapt：面向人形机器人的工作空间条件化伴随语音手势生成
translated_abstract: 机器人的伴随语音手势不仅要适应语音和自身机体结构，还必须适应可供执行动作的工作空间。由于同一段语音可以伴随不同的手势，机器人可以对工作空间限制作出响应，例如在墙边说话时的手势选择。在这些场景中，机器人应当以合适的动作做出手势，而不是简单地对未加约束的动作进行事后修正。为实现这一目标，我们提出了GestAdapt，这是一个工作空间条件化框架，将伴随语音手势的生成以给定的手腕工作空间为条件。该框架通过共享的运动表示从六个互补的伴随语音语料库中学习，并支持重定向到不同的机器人本体。定量评估表明，生成的动作在遵守工作空间约束的同时，仍与真实运动分布保持接近。在一项用户研究中，在修改后的工作空间约束下生成的手势获得了可观……
tldr: 提出了GestAdapt，一个以规定的手腕工作空间为条件的人形机器人伴随语音手势生成框架，能够在遵守工作空间约束的同时生成贴近真实运动分布的手势动作，并支持重定向到不同的机器人本体。
en_tdlr: GestAdapt is a workspace-conditioned co-speech gesture generation framework for humanoid robots that adapts gestures to prescribed wrist workspaces while staying close to the real motion distribution and supporting retargeting across different robot embodiments.
